notes:
Snapshot: mid-size e-discovery provider focused on regulated corp. Use-case = legal/compliance RAG across contracts, litigation corpora, audit trails. Key asks:
- Scale: initial index target 6–12M documents (mixed PDFs, PST extracts, OCR), expect growth 20% qtr
- Latency: interactive search SLA: median <120ms for embeddings retrieval, end-to-end top-5 rerank <600ms (95th <900ms)
- Cost sensitivity: want guidance on $/query at 5000 qps-equivalent batch vs burst, tolerates caching and quantized models
- Model preferences: open embeddings (high-dim dense), prefer on-prem/private model variants for PII, fallback hosted for non-sensitive workloads
- Security: strict retention + audit logging; retention policy: 7+ yrs for certain doc classes; immutable audit trail required for legal hold
- Integration: SSO (SAML), enterprise KMS, SIEM feeds, long-term audit log export (>=10 years), eDiscovery export formats (E01, PST)
Quotes: "We cannot send raw case files to public endpoints — chain of custody is non-negotiable."
Notes from call: AE + SE ran through initial whiteboard on routing (sensitive docs -> private cluster, public non-sensitive -> hosted). Customer asks for runbook for legal hold and retention purge flows.

2026-01-24: Security deep-dive (SE) - SSO/KMS requirements, compliance team present

poe_details: POC scope doc (drive) outlines dataset, ingestion pipeline, sample redaction rules, expected metrics: recall@100, MRR, p95 latency. SE to run quantized embedding pipeline on customer-capacity (8x A10G equiv) in private VPC.
deployment_notes: Plan: Private control plane + on-prem index nodes in a customer VPC. Hybrid routing: sensitive case buckets pinned to private cluster; public knowledge base shards pinned to Redwood hosted. KV cache allowed but encrypted at rest. Need network diagram and firewall/IP allowlist for procurement.
procurement_risks: Legal wants liability language re: discovery spoliation, retention mismatch. Procurement timeline tied to SOC2 evidence and indemnity clauses. Potential vendor legal review week of 2026-04-20.
technical_constraints: Documents include heavy OCR noise, binary attachments (images), expected average doc length 8k tokens; embedding batch throughput must consider tokenization costs. Customer requests no outbound PII to 3rd-party telemetry by default.
pricing_concerns: Customer requested two scenarios: (A) all-private with higher ARR; (B) hybrid with cost-limited hosted fallback. Wants modeled $/query with 10M monthly queries and peak 2k QPS bursts. Also asked for ops cost estimate for 24/7 support.
pm_notes: Product ask: automated retention-policy engine (time + legal hold flag), immutable audit log export, search-level RBAC. Feature hit list added to product board.
final_comments: Customer engaged, technically motivated, procurement sensitive. Next milestone = private VPC POC results (throughput, p95 latency) + security attestation. If POC meets latency/cost, forecast to convert to 12-month committed Dedicated or Private contract.
